description: Recorded DialPad call event webhook deliveries. DialPad does not publish a machine-readable schema that can be vendored the way the Asterisk project publishes its REST Interface declarations, so this contract is payload-bound rather than specification-bound: it pins the production normalizer to concrete deliveries and enforces a coverage floor over every provider token the normalizer interprets.
payloadEncoding: snake_case JSON delivered either as a bare body or as an HS256 JWT whose payload claim carries the call event
